name: Nullseam Ghostwalk Infiltrator Full Rig
description: A skintight full-body underlayer in matte charcoal signal-null fabric, topped with a quick-strip modular overshell — loose panels that detach via single-pull magnetic seams to instantly change the wearer's silhouette and color profile. Soft-soled split-toe shoes with gecko-adhesive pads complete the rig, and a slim balaclava with tinted eye mesh seals the look. The entire kit compresses into a palm-sized roll for pre-op concealment.
functionality: Single-pull magnetic seams allow full silhouette change in under four seconds; gecko-adhesive soles provide surface adhesion up to 85kg on smooth vertical surfaces; full kit compresses to 180ml volume.
what_it_says: You won't see this person unless they decide you should.
story_hooks: The quick-strip outer layer was left at the scene deliberately — someone is framing a different operative.
The gecko pads are losing adhesion in the cold; the wearer realizes mid-climb on a Spire facade.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting shadow beneath loose, deconstructed modular panels that hang like tactical geometry. The balaclava and tinted eye mesh create an unsettling anonymity—pure infiltrator aesthetic. When fully assembled, it reads as a living camouflage system; when stripped, the tight base layer beneath suggests surgical precision.
physical_description.fit: Compression underlayer (second-skin tight); modular overshell panels (deliberately loose and quick-release, designed to shed in seconds). Balaclava fits snug against the skull. Shoes are minimalist and adhesive-gripped for silent movement.
physical_description.primary_material: Underlayer: signal-null matte charcoal synth-composite (radar-absorbing weave). Overshell panels: treated ballistic fabric with magnetic-seam integration. Balaclava: breathable signal-dampening mesh with polymeric tint. Shoes: synthetic split-toe with biomimetic gecko-pad adhesion strips.
physical_description.texture: Underlayer is impossibly smooth, almost liquid in appearance—matte, non-reflective. Overshell panels have a subtle ribbed structure for grip and panel tensioning. Balaclava mesh is fine and translucent but visually obscuring. Shoe soles show textured adhesion pads.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary matte charcoal throughout (signal-null base). Overshell panels in graduated grays and deep slate with accent striping in faint infrared-invisible threading. Tinted eye mesh renders a dark amber glow. No bright accents—pure operational black market.
physical_description.closures: Single-pull magnetic seams on all modular panels (explosive quick-release design). Balaclava friction-sealed at neck. Shoes use gecko-adhesion pads (no fasteners—adhesion on demand).
distinctive_features: Magnetic quick-strip modular overshell panels (instant silhouette change)
Tinted eye mesh in balaclava (anonymity + light filtering)
No visible branding or ID markers
Reinforced seam architecture at stress points
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 black market / ungoverned underground — dark-side military-grade infiltration tech. Price point accessible only through shadow economies.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by extraction operatives, data thieves, resistance assets, and deep-cover agents. Signals: I operate in the margins. I leave no trace. This is not corpo—this is combat.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on first use (black market product = carefully maintained). As worn, the underlayer shows subtle stress creasing; modular panels develop micro-abrasions from repeated magnetic detachment. Balaclava develops slight fraying at edges from extended wear. Shoe gecko-pads degrade with use and require periodic cleaning/re-adhesion.

Mid-strip pose, one gray panel peeling away via magnetic seam. Dark warehouse backdrop with sodium vapor glow casting long shadows. Gecko-adhesion split-toe shoes grip the concrete floor.
